text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day! Usually I'd
spend it
working or simply enjoying
some downtime, but
this year...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! The meeting place is this way!
Come on!

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text:
Okay, it's time to get you part-timers all
trained
up. First, please take a look at
the materials I've
handed out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I told Ines Fujin that I want to use my
free time
this week working the same
one-off gigs as her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I figured that if we both work, it would
cut the
time we need to spend in half,
freeing her up for
more training before
our next race, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh my god! Trainer is being attacked by
birds!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It turns out that learning the ropes of a
new job
isn't as easy as Ines Fujin makes
it seem...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Are you really okay?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's great you showed up like a
responsible
worker, but sometimes you
need the courage to
admit you've bitten
off more than you can chew.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Okay, okay. First, turn your head this
way.
You've got a little bed head going
on.
choice_data_list_en: Today's the day I'll give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, I find myself helping out at
the venue
of a large event, endlessly
wrapping chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, based on the instructions,
wrapping them
like this should be fine, I
guess.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, never underestimate the ultimate

part-timer! This kind of work is child's
play!
choice_data_list: アイネス、ラッピング上手だね！
choice_data_list_en: Ines, you're great at wrapping gifts!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, about your wrapping

technique...

text_block_list.name: Short-Haired Part-Timer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You wrapped those so
beautifully! What's
your secret?!

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text:
Seriously! You've got some real talent!
Think you
could help the group over
there, too?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're sure getting a lot of praise,
Trainer!
I'm almost jealous...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Guess so...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
But at this rate, I won't be able to teach
you anything...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? You're no match for me in terms of
speed,
though!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's pick up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So we knuckle down in our little corner
of the
venue, single-mindedly wrapping
chocolate after
chocolate, until...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Good work today!

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text:
Excellent work, everyone! I've prepared
some
gifts as thanks, but make sure you
only take one
each.

text_block_list.name: Part Timers
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Say, Trainer. Go ahead and grab
two—you can
have mine.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's fine! Hurry up and get in line for
some
chocolates!
choice_data_list: えっ、でもアイネスの分は……

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I mean, this is pretty much the only
thing I can
do for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Acting sulky for some reason, Ines Fujin
gives me
a shove, and I go collect my
two sets of
chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So we knuckle down in our little corner
of the
venue, single-mindedly wrapping
chocolate after
chocolate, until...

text_block_list.name: Event Coordinator
text_block_list.text:
Boy, we'd sure have been in trouble
without your
help! As a thank-you,
please take this box of
assorted
chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...They really worked you hard today,
huh?
choice_data_list: ありがとうございます！

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Even had you helping out the other staff.
You
didn't show a glimpse of your
hopeless side.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
choice_data_list: ご褒美でもらったチョコは一緒に食べよう！
choice_data_list_en: Let's share the chocolates we got as a reward!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Pft! Hehe, ahaha! Okay, good idea!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'm sorry, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I kinda got all upset back there. And
over
something so silly, too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Let me buy you a drink to go with those

chocolates. I've gotta treat you once in a
while.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You worked hard today, and this is to

commemorate a job well done! ...Though
I can
only spare a hundred yen or so.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin returns from the convenience
store with
coffee, and we stuff our
cheeks with delicious
chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we share this pleasant moment, I see
a
beaming smile spread across her face.
